scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @we-build/web" "npm run dev -w @we-build/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @we-build/domain && npm run build -w @we-build/web && npm run build -w @we-build/api
scripts.check: npm run check -w @we-build/domain && npm run check -w @we-build/web && npm run check -w @we-build/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @we-build/domain && npm run test -w @we-build/api
